record.question: Which of the following statements is true, according to Section 94 of the BSA, 2023, regarding oral evidence ?
options: Oral evidence is admissible to prove the terms of a written contract
Oral evidence is admissible to contradict the contents of a written contract
Oral evidence is admissible to prove facts mentioned in the document, even if the fact is unrelated to the main contract or disposition
Oral evidence is never admissible if there is a written document.
